subject: Provisional voucher request — suspected prefetch/replay duplication causing mid-cycle spike
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@vendly.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@vendly.com
Date: 2027-06-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Unexpected mid-cycle charge spike — request for evidence + provisional voucher

Hi Rohan / Ben,

We just received the mid-cycle statement and saw a ~4.6x token increase between 2027-06-12 and 2027-06-14 compared to our typical window. This is flagged on our side as an unexpected spike and our finance team has put the invoice on payment hold pending reconciliation.

Quick context: Vendly runs a nightly prefetch job that pulls data for embeddings. We use a separate replay pipeline for production queries. We suspect the spike happened during the prefetch window but need Redwood's confirmation and hourly evidence (token counts by hour, session ids, and any repeated request ids) before we can clear the hold.

Can you:
- Share hourly token counts and the raw request IDs for 2027-06-12 through 2027-06-14
- Confirm whether any replay/aux-model routing changes were rolled during that period
- Provide a provisional voucher or credit hold while we reconcile (our procurement team requires something formal to avoid collections)

I've attached a small sample export from our side: usage_samples_20270610-20270614.csv which includes our internal session ids and timestamps.

Thanks — Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Head of Platform Engineering, Vendly Inc.
A: +1 415-555-0193

---
Attachment: usage_samples_20270610-20270614.csv (CSV, 183 rows)
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@vendly.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-15T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected mid-cycle charge spike — request for evidence + provisional voucher

Hi Alicia — thanks for the heads up and the sample export. I'm sorry this hit your finance team mid-cycle. We've opened HS-00089321 on our side and will prioritize a granular look.

Immediate next steps from Redwood:
- We'll pull hourly token counts and request_ids for 2027-06-12 through 2027-06-14 and map them to your provided session ids.
- Ben will lead the trace extraction; we'll produce a compressed trace (prefetch-trace-0613.gz) plus an interim reconciliation CSV.
- Vanessa (payments/collections) — can you advise on what formal language Vendly needs for a provisional voucher/hold? If you can send sample PO or wording, we can attach it to the invoice hold note.

One quick question for your team: did you have any large backfill or replay job scheduled that might have overlapped the prefetch window? That'll help us bias root-cause options.

I'll update by end of day tomorrow (2027-06-16) with the first set of logs.

Best,
Rohan Mehta
Account Executive — Midmarket
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-16T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: initial trace plan for Vendly spike (prefetch suspicion)

Rohan / Vanessa — quick internal note before I pull traces: initial hypothesis is duplicate prefetch batches + a late replay that re-used cached prefixes without KV dedupe. I suspect an aux-model routing fallback triggered at 03:00 UTC on 2027-06-13 that re-issued many prefetched requests.

Planned artifacts: 
- hourly_token_dump_20270612-0614.csv (token counts by hour)
- preftrace_prefetch-0613.gz (server-side request-level trace containing request_id and model_variant)
- vendly-mapped-session-ids.txt (mapping where we can match your internal session ids to our request ids)

I'll attach preftrace_prefetch-0613.gz to HS-00089321 and share the mapping file once the join completes. We should also request Vendly's S3 path for raw request ids so we can cross-check.

Tip for collections: if procurement needs a PO reference, ask them to send a signed PO number and we'll add a hold memo to the invoice. If they need a formal voucher, Vanessa can draft a one-off credit authorizing a provisional hold pending reconciliation.

— Ben
Sr. Technical Account Manager
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: preftrace_prefetch-0613.gz (gzip, ~4.2MB)
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@vendly.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@vendly.com
Date: 2027-06-17T07:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected mid-cycle charge spike — request for evidence + provisional voucher

Thanks, Rohan and Ben.

We did run a backfill on 2027-06-12 between 02:20–03:30 UTC to regenerate embeddings for a new model rollout; that job writes to the same namespace as the nightly prefetch. We did not expect production replays to fire against re-ingested objects, but we've observed duplicate request ids on our side (I'll attach a short list).

Procurement is okay with a provisional voucher if Redwood can provide: 
- a short voucher memo (language: "Provisional credit pending reconciliation of disputed usage 2027-06-12 to 2027-06-14")
- estimated timeline for final reconciliation (we need this within 7 business days)

S3 path with our raw logs (redacted): s3://vendly-logs/ingest/2027/06/12/{batch-uuid}/request_ids.log

Attached: vendly-session-ids-0612-0614.txt — first 120 session ids matching the spike window. We'll pause payment on the disputed lines if Redwood issues the voucher and confirms collections will be deferred.

Appreciate the quick attention.
— Alicia

---
Attachment: vendly-session-ids-0612-0614.txt (TXT, 120 lines)
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@vendly.com>, procurement@vendly.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-18T15:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected mid-cycle charge spike — request for evidence + provisional voucher

Alicia — thanks for the S3 path and the session id list. We have enough to start the join and should be able to deliver the first reconciliation artifacts by EOD 2027-06-20. Here are the concrete next steps and commitments from Redwood: 

1) By 2027-06-20 23:59 PDT: deliver hourly_token_dump_20270612-0614.csv and vendly-mapped-session-ids.txt (we'll mark request_ids that appear duplicated more than once)
2) By 2027-06-23 18:00 PDT: final reconciliation report and proposed credit (if duplication confirmed)
3) Collections hold: Vanessa — can you please issue a provisional voucher memo using the wording Vendly requested and attach it to invoice INV-20270614-VENDLY? Please confirm back to Alicia and CC me.

Temporary voucher language suggestion (Vanessa, feel free to edit):
"Provisional credit pending reconciliation of disputed usage 2027-06-12 to 2027-06-14. Credit will be finalized upon mutual agreement on the reconciliation report (expected by 2027-06-23). Collections will be deferred until reconciliation completes unless otherwise agreed in writing."

Alicia — if that timeline works for you we will treat the invoice as under dispute and will not escalate to collections in the interim. If procurement needs a PO number included in the voucher memo, please send it and we'll include it.

I'll keep HS-00089321 updated with artifacts and will share the Drive link once the CSVs are uploaded: https://drive.redwood.com/teams/sales/vendly/recon_notes_20270618

Thanks — talk soon.

Rohan Mehta
Account Executive — Midmarket
Redwood Inference

Attachments (to follow): hourly_token_dump_20270612-0614.csv, vendly-mapped-session-ids.txt
